classes.name: Seimo rinkimai
classes.finest_note: Counted by polling district (apylinkė); stations abroad count with their constituency (since 2020 the world-Lithuanians constituency). Polling districts are address lists, not mapped areas.
classes.note: 141 members (Constitution art. 55): 71 in single-member constituencies, two rounds unless one candidate wins outright (plurality in one round in 2000), and 70 by nationwide list PR with a 5% threshold (7% for joint lists) and preference votes. Vacant constituency seats go to new elections (nauji rinkimai).

cadence.runoff_rule: Single-member constituencies: a second round between the top two within 15 days when no candidate wins a majority (Rinkimų kodeksas).
cadence.locator: https://www.lrs.lt/home/Konstitucija/Konstitucija.htm (art. 57: regular Seimas elections on the second Sunday of October of the year the mandate ends; art. 58: early elections)
cadence.vacancy_rule: A vacant single-member seat is filled at a new election; a vacant list seat passes to the next candidate on the list (Rinkimų kodeksas).

access.evidence: Static result pages and tab-separated files for Seimas elections, by polling district (apylinkė); the lt.vrk pipeline reads them from 2017 on.
The Commission's election pages; the site front answers automated clients with a browser challenge, so its reach back before 2017 was not confirmed in this survey.

classes.name: Respublikos Prezidento rinkimai
classes.note: Direct two-round election for five years (Constitution arts. 78-81); a first-round win needs a majority of those voting with turnout of at least half the electorate, or a third of all voters when turnout is lower.

cadence.runoff_rule: A second round between the top two two weeks after the first (Constitution art. 81).

classes.finest_note: Counted by polling district (apylinkė); the Commission's pages also total by municipality.
classes.note: Called by the Seimas or on the demand of 300,000 voters (Constitution art. 9); mandatory for Chapters 1 and 14 of the Constitution (art. 148). Turnout and approval quorums apply (Law on Referendums).

classes.note: Each municipality elects its council for four years by list PR with preference votes (Constitution art. 119; Rinkimų kodeksas); independent candidates may run since 2015 through public election committees. Council size scales with population.

classes.name: Vietos gyventojų apklausos
classes.disposition_reason: Consultative polls run by each municipality under the Local Self-Government Law, not by the Commission; no central register of polls or their results was found.

classes.name: Seniūnaičių rinkimai
classes.disposition_reason: Ward representatives are chosen by residents' meetings or polls the municipal administration organizes (Local Self-Government Law); no ballot is run by the Commission and no results are published.

classes.name: Netiesioginiai rinkimai
classes.name_en: Indirect elections (Seimas Speaker, Prime Minister's approval, council-elected mayors before 2015)
classes.disposition_reason: Chosen by a vote of an elected body, not by voters.

classes.name: Teisėjų skyrimas
classes.disposition_reason: Judges are appointed by the President or the Seimas (Constitution arts. 103, 112); no judicial office is filled by popular vote.

classes.name: Partijų vidaus rinkimai
classes.disposition_reason: Parties choose candidates under their own statutes; the state runs no primaries.

classes.name: Piliečių įstatymų leidybos ir referendumo iniciatyvos
classes.disposition_reason: Signature collection (50,000 for a bill, 300,000 for a referendum), not a vote; an initiative that reaches a ballot is counted under referendums.

classes.name: Aukščiausiosios Tarybos-Atkuriamojo Seimo rinkimai (1990)
classes.note: 141 single-member constituencies, two rounds, with repeat voting where turnout fell short. The council restored independence on 11 March 1990 and sat until the 1992 Seimas.

dates.quote: 1990 m. vasaris – Aukščiausiosios Tarybos-Atkuriamojo Seimo rinkimai
dates.note: Runoffs on 4, 7, 8, and 10 March and repeat voting in April 1990 left open.

classes.name: Liaudies Seimo rinkimai (1940)
classes.note: A single-list election staged under Soviet occupation on 14-15 July 1940; the assembly requested admission to the USSR.

dates.note: Voting ran over 14 and 15 July 1940; contests not yet counted.

classes.name: Lietuvos SSR Aukščiausiosios Tarybos ir vietinių tarybų rinkimai (1941-1990)
classes.name_en: Lithuanian SSR Supreme Soviet and local soviet elections
classes.disposition_reason: Single-candidate elections under occupation whose district results survive only in Soviet press and archives; no official publisher of the results was found.

classes.name: TSRS institucijų rinkimai Lietuvoje
classes.name_en: Elections to USSR bodies held in Lithuania (to 1989)
classes.disposition_reason: Elections to the bodies of another state (the USSR Supreme Soviet and the 1989 Congress of People's Deputies); they belong to a USSR census.
